_evidence: Observed. The spec was fetched live from the tenant; the live probes were executed read-only with GET only.
_authNote: No authentication token of any kind was read, captured or recorded. /en/test/RESTful.jsp renders live Basic and JWT tokens; every extraction here was structure-only (element names, component types, spec text) and all live calls rode the existing browser session cookie.

howFound.1: /en/test/RESTful.jsp is an ExtJS page, not static HTML. Its record-type pickers are ExtJS components: splitbuttons 'Record Sets' (menucheckitems base / wantCodeTables / wantIssues), 'Core Fields' (coreRequired / coreEditable / coreReadOnly), 'Firm Fields' (firmEditable / firmReadOnly), a tagfield 'typeFld' (Types, 227 entries) and a 'Load' button (Ext id button-1019).
howFound.2: Load does not call a generator endpoint. The page embeds an iframe at /swagger/index.html, i.e. stock Swagger UI; the pickers only filter what that UI displays.
howFound.3: Swagger UI is configured with url = '/rest/api-docs/swagger'. That path returns the full OpenAPI 3.0.1 document as YAML (132,839 bytes). Fetching it directly makes the whole interactive exercise unnecessary.
howFound.conclusion: Derived: the REST contract is fully self-describing at GET /rest/api-docs/swagger. No need to drive the UI.

api.title: Lucernex API
api.securityNote: The spec declares NO securitySchemes. Authentication is out-of-band: the RESTful.jsp page offers a Basic Authentication token and a JWT Bearer token for copy-paste. Observed (labels only).

headline: WRITE VERBS EXIST. 160 operations over 141 paths: 104 GET, 40 POST, 7 PUT, 9 DELETE. The corpus's 617-GraphQL-queries-vs-3-mutations picture does not describe the REST surface, which is fully CRUD.

genericCrudSurface.writeBodySchema: BusinessObject — {botype (required), clientID, href, match, projectEntityName, modifiedByID, modified, uuid, updateOnly, fields:[Field], extSubFields:[Field], children:[BusinessObject]}. Both application/json and application/xml are accepted.
genericCrudSurface.writeResponseSchema: ImportResults — {successes:[ImportSuccess], errors:[ImportError]}. Note it is a BULK-style result envelope even for a single record, and a 200 can therefore carry errors; do not treat HTTP 200 as success without reading errors[].
genericCrudSurface.clientIDIsTheImportKey: BOMapClientRecordID (UI label '<Object> ClientID') is the addressable /clientid/ key. Derived, from the field definition in bbw-platform-tables.json.

liveProbes._method: GET only, same-origin session cookie, values discarded — shapes recorded, not data.
